_about: The cut list for the call scene: stretches of the raw call recording (recordings/call.m4a, 115s) that make the 40s the video uses, played in order. { in, out } in seconds of the RAW recording. Cut at the gaps between turns (found with silencedetect and whisper word times). Dropped: 'This call is transcribed' and the account number in the greeting, the Wednesday and $35 read-backs with their 'Yes', the $20 read-back and its 'Yes', most of the wait while Yoshua approves, 'Please go ahead and move the payment...', and PacePay's last line (its start came out in a very low voice), so the call ends on the lender giving the reference. Re-run: node scripts/video/align-call.mjs

cuts.note: PacePay: I'm PacePay, an AI assistant calling on behalf of Yoshua, with Yoshua's permission
PacePay: I'm calling to ask if this month's payment can move to Friday, November 13th, with no fee. / Lender: We can do Wednesday.
PacePay: Could we do Friday the 13th instead, with no fee?
Lender: Friday works, but there's a $35 fee.
PacePay: Understood. Is there any chance you'd waive the fee?
PacePay: Thanks, let me run that by Yoshua real quick. (plus ~1.9s of the hold, while the approval text shows)
PacePay: Thanks for holding. Yoshua approved.
PacePay: Could I get a reference number for that?
Lender: Sure. Your reference number is A7732.
